name: Editorial Campaign

approval.notes: Reference campaigns are human-review-pending; this is a proposed reusable visual family, not an approved replacement brand system.

description: A large-type, modular editorial campaign language: Jost hierarchy, deliberate negative space and text/photo counterpoint. Different slide rhythms remain recognizably related.

source_of_truth.comment: Asya'da Eğitim has approved identity assets but no complete approved brand-system.md. These campaign choices are review-only.

references.note: airy photo-and-type editorial; D-04 / P-01 compositions
larger fixed primary lockups; balanced photo windows
contrasting backgrounds, assertive hierarchy, changing photo pace
bold editorial questions and alternate color rhythm

hard_locks.identity: Exact pre-approved V-01 identity only; never reconstruct, redraw, typeset or transform a canonical lockup.

lockup_preference.interior: D-04 or P-01 only when minimum width and clearspace pass

hard_locks.typeface: Jost (campaign production family; not a new canonical brand typography approval)
hard_locks.copy: Preserve approved Turkish copy, official slogan and CTA exactly; no generated logo/wordmark text.
hard_locks.source: Editable HTML/CSS/SVG and actual browser PNG render; optional AI only as separately composited non-text, non-logo imagery.

soft_constants: An assertive Jost headline and supporting editorial information hierarchy.
Generous, intentional negative space; restrained rules, meta labels and folio when useful.
Photo and headline counterpoint; no mandatory photo in every slide.
At least two visibly different composition archetypes in a typical 5-slide set.
Paper surfaces are the default high-frequency institutional anchor; red and ink support focal contrast.

color_behavior.default_guideline_for_five_slides: Prefer three or more predominantly paper-based slides; this is an art-direction heuristic, not a rigid uniform-background requirement.
color_behavior.contrast_rule: Contrast-test all foreground/background pairs. Always use the appropriate approved lockup color variant; never recolor an SVG.
color_behavior.variation_rule: Adjacent slides may switch surfaces; preserve paper as the recognisable visual home across the sequence unless the user selects a different allowed color_mode.

layout_grammar.sequence_rule: Select at least three different interior/cover compositions in a five-slide carousel, varying typography/photo balance and whitespace; never cycle one identical composition repeatedly.
layout_grammar.text_fit: Line breaks, optical weight, whitespace and image crops adapt to actual Turkish copy; no shrinking below legibility solely to match a screenshot.
layout_grammar.media: Photographs are support layers, not the mechanism that typesets content; do not make unverifiable university/campus claims.
anti_patterns: uniform paper-only pages with no rhythm
all slides as heavy red posters

color_mode.description: Sequence-level distribution, not a fixed single-slide background.

layout_rhythm.description: Editorial cadence, never a single hard-coded template.

interior_bias.description: A bias, not every slide's single layout.

photo_density.description: Total photo prominence; optional imagery must be sourced or authorized.

cta_presentation.description: Changes visual emphasis, never exact approved CTA wording.

institutional-paper.label: Kurumsal krem
institutional-paper.summary: Paper is the main surface; moderate photos, balanced informational rhythm.

campaign-dynamic.label: Dinamik kampanya
campaign-dynamic.summary: Alternating photo windows and typographic contrasts with paper/red alternation.

photo-editorial.label: Fotoğraf odaklı editoryal
photo-editorial.summary: Large documentary-looking image areas integrated with generous paper-based typography.

ink-accent.label: Kontrast vurgulu
ink-accent.summary: Controlled ink contrasts and large type, with paper returning across the sequence.

required_checks: brand identity and chosen complete SVG lockup hashes verified against canonical manifest
actual HTML/CSS/SVG source preserved and Chromium/Playwright PNG raster verified at target size
legible Turkish copy, typography, contrast, line-wrap and logo clearspace checked on all slides
sequence has visual rhythm but consistent editorial family; selected variations logged
brand and creative human approvals remain distinct; no automatic brand lock or Instagram publication

evaluation.method: three controlled renders: same preset across two briefs (A/B), then same brief with another preset (A/C); review family recognition vs layout variation against historical carousel-01/v2/v3/02

reference_instagram_posts.role: Shanghai carousel: city photo and multi-photo editorial layout
large headline integrated with aspirational photograph

preview_quality_contract.source_preference: Existing published posts are a visual quality reference, not new approvals of logo, type, or source image provenance.

identity_gate.note: Complete outlined paths must be byte-for-byte identical to the canonical SVG record; brand name must not be a substitute HTML text block.

density_and_layout_gate.logo_positions: Can vary across safe, contrast-appropriate placements; each slide preserves clearspace.
density_and_layout_gate.image_usage: Use editorial crops, not five stock photo slots or fake university photographs; record actual provenance.
density_and_layout_gate.composition: Maintain headline/image integration, layered modules, legible explanatory microcopy and variation in photo scale.
density_and_layout_gate.visual_inspection: Compare full-page sequences at mobile scale against the existing campaign exemplars; check visual density and content legibility, not palette alone.

test_acceptance: All five slides render at target size from editable HTML/CSS/SVG.
Every slide composites an authentic complete lockup, SHA-256 checked and visible in pixels.
No seal-only substitute and no manually typed faux wordmark.
No mechanical identical bottom bars across the series.
Photos, headline, information modules and color rhythm meet a human visual-review gate.
